notes.title: 0.118b
notes.content:
[u]Gameplay[/u]
Added Challenge Mode for single and co-op wave leaderboards

[u]UI[/u]
Updated silo controls to allow viewing of all silo's queues.

notes.title: 0.116b
notes.content:
[u]Gameplay[/u]
[list]
[*] Enlarge visuals of the ammo counter in the target reticule and also indicate the fire state as not ready in the reticule when the turret shield is regenerating
[*] Update the meteor event to ensure small sizes only during the start of the match and allow it to scale to larger sizes upto 10 mins. 
[*] Improve the damage cloud visual on missles to be more pronounced to be clearer that they have taken damage.  This also becomes more intense as it takes more damage.
[*] Force cursor display when switching to view oppenent.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.115b
notes.content:
[u]Bug fix[/u]
Fixed a rare race condition that could cause players not to be applied to a position / player slot when joining a match.

notes.title: 0.213b
notes.content:
[u]Gameplay[/u]
[list]
[*] Add accuracy to survival mode score
[*] Reduce shot limit time allowing rapid shots when ammo is available
[*] Adjust shot cost and add tooltip information to show the increase.
[/list]
[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed asteroid damage from cities not appearing in the post match graph.
[*] Fixed some missiles from visibly changing direction on first entry in VR introduced in last patch
[/list]

notes.title: 0.212b
notes.content:
[u]Balance improvements[/u]
[list]
[*] 2v2 - increased base income to offset less cities
[*] Survival - Reduced initial threat per wave and added an extrai increase in per 5 waves[/list]
[u]Gameplay[/u]
Updated the Evador missile to smoothly change direction

[u]Bug Fixes[/u]
Fix video and audio sub menu cursor key navigation.
